test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three articles are bought at Rs.180 each. One of them is sold at a loss of 10%. If the other two articles are sold so as to gain 25% on the whole transaction, then what is the gain percentage on the two articles?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of three articles = Rs. 180 each

Loss = 10%

Gain = 25% 

**Formula used:**

Gain = SP – CP

Gain% = Gain/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

CP of three articles = Rs. (180 × 3) = Rs. 540

Total gain% on whole transaction = 25%

So, 

SP of the three articles = Rs. (540 × 125/100)

⇒ Rs. 675

SP of the first article = Rs. (180 × 90)/100 

⇒ Rs. 162

CP of the other two articles = Rs. (180 × 2) = Rs. 360

SP of the other two articles = Rs. (675 – 162) = Rs. 513

Gain on two articles =Rs. (513 – 360) = Rs. 153

Gain% on the two articles = (153/360 × 100)

⇒ (15,300/360)

⇒ 42.5%

**∴ The required gain% on the two articles is 42.5%**
